Architecture Principles.name: Digital-First Product Strategy
Architecture Principles.description: All heat pump products must be designed with digital connectivity and smart capabilities as core features
Architecture Principles.rationale: The future of HVAC systems is smart and connected. Digital capabilities enable energy optimization, predictive maintenance, and superior customer experience.
Architecture Principles.implications: All product development must include IoT sensors, connectivity modules, and cloud integration. Legacy products without digital capabilities will be phased out.

Architecture Principles.name: API-First Integration
Architecture Principles.description: All systems and applications must provide well-documented APIs for seamless integration
Architecture Principles.rationale: API-first approach enables rapid integration with partners, customer systems, and internal applications while maintaining flexibility and scalability.
Architecture Principles.implications: Every new system must expose its functionality through RESTful APIs or GraphQL. Legacy systems must be retrofitted with API layers.

Architecture Principles.name: Unified Data Platform
Architecture Principles.description: All business data must be accessible through a single, unified data platform with consistent schemas and APIs
Architecture Principles.rationale: Unified data access enables advanced analytics, AI/ML applications, and real-time decision making across all business functions.
Architecture Principles.implications: Data silos must be eliminated. All applications must conform to enterprise data models. Master data management is mandatory.

Architecture Principles.name: Real-Time Analytics First
Architecture Principles.description: Analytics and insights must be available in real-time to enable immediate decision making
Architecture Principles.rationale: Energy efficiency optimization and predictive maintenance require real-time data processing and immediate response capabilities.
Architecture Principles.implications: Streaming data architectures, edge computing for IoT data, and real-time dashboards are required.

Architecture Principles.name: Cloud-First Architecture
Architecture Principles.description: New applications must be designed for cloud deployment with cloud-native patterns and capabilities
Architecture Principles.rationale: Cloud platforms provide scalability, resilience, and cost efficiency required for IoT and analytics workloads.
Architecture Principles.implications: Applications must be containerized, stateless, and designed for horizontal scaling. Cloud services are preferred over on-premises solutions.

Architecture Principles.name: Microservices Architecture
Architecture Principles.description: Applications should be decomposed into loosely coupled, independently deployable microservices
Architecture Principles.rationale: Microservices enable independent development teams, technology diversity, and granular scaling of application components.
Architecture Principles.implications: Monolithic applications must be gradually decomposed. Service mesh and API gateways are required for service communication.

Architecture Principles.name: Zero Trust Security Model
Architecture Principles.description: Security must be built into every component with continuous verification and least privilege access
Architecture Principles.rationale: IoT devices and cloud connectivity expand the attack surface requiring comprehensive security measures.
Architecture Principles.implications: Identity verification for all users and devices, encrypted communication, network segmentation, and continuous monitoring are mandatory.

Architecture Principles.name: Data Protection by Design
Architecture Principles.description: Personal and business data must be protected through encryption, access controls, and privacy measures
Architecture Principles.rationale: GDPR compliance and customer trust require comprehensive data protection throughout the data lifecycle.
Architecture Principles.implications: Data encryption at rest and in transit, role-based access controls, data anonymization, and audit trails are required.

Architecture Principles.name: Automation First
Architecture Principles.description: Manual processes must be automated to improve efficiency, reduce errors, and enable scaling
Architecture Principles.rationale: Automation reduces operational costs, improves consistency, and enables teams to focus on value-added activities.
Architecture Principles.implications: Infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and self-healing systems are mandatory.

Architecture Principles.name: Observability by Design
Architecture Principles.description: All systems must provide comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing capabilities
Architecture Principles.rationale: Observability enables proactive issue detection, performance optimization, and effective troubleshooting.
Architecture Principles.implications: Structured logging, distributed tracing, metrics collection, and alerting must be built into all applications.

Architecture Principles.name: Resilience by Design
Architecture Principles.description: Systems must be designed to handle failures gracefully and recover automatically
Architecture Principles.rationale: High availability is critical for IoT services, manufacturing operations, and customer satisfaction.
Architecture Principles.implications: Circuit breakers, bulkhead patterns, graceful degradation, and automated failover are required.

Architecture Principles.name: Sustainability by Design
Architecture Principles.description: Technology choices must minimize environmental impact and support sustainability goals
Architecture Principles.rationale: Environmental responsibility is core to our heat pump business and customer expectations.
Architecture Principles.implications: Energy-efficient technologies, optimized resource usage, and carbon footprint measurement are required.

Architecture Principles.name: Open Standards and Interoperability
Architecture Principles.description: Technology choices must favor open standards and industry protocols over proprietary solutions
Architecture Principles.rationale: Open standards ensure long-term compatibility, vendor independence, and easier integration with partner systems.
Architecture Principles.implications: Prefer open-source solutions, standard protocols (MQTT, HTTP, etc.), and avoid vendor lock-in scenarios.

Architecture Principles.name: Continuous Innovation and Improvement
Architecture Principles.description: Architecture must evolve continuously based on technological advances and business needs
Architecture Principles.rationale: Rapid technological change requires continuous architectural evolution to maintain competitive advantage.
Architecture Principles.implications: Regular architecture reviews, technology radar, proof of concepts, and gradual migration strategies are required.
